It also properly updates `CHANGELOG.md` and `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md`. However, there are a few minor gaps: first, in the plain-object rejection test (`onErrorNonError.acceptance.test.ts`), the candidate fails to assert that `error.cause` is set to the plain object as required by the second acceptance criterion (even though the implementation does set it). Second, the candidate leaves behind a `.lore/dod.md` scratch file and creates two new separate test files (`onErrorNonError.acceptance.test.ts` and `onErrorNonError.test.ts`) instead of adding the test to `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts` like the reference. Finally, the reference uses `JSON.stringify` before falling back to `String(error)` so plain objects don't just produce `'[object Object]'` as the error message.
